issue.title: fix(acp): distinguish readiness-gate failure from real turn failure in session/prompt stopReason

steps: write a file named probe.txt containing ok in the workspace
expected: A turn whose task succeeded ends with stopReason end_turn (or a dedicated readiness outcome), not error (issue's expected behaviour).
defect: The file is written and verified, but session/prompt returns stopReason "error" because the balanced-preset final-readiness verification gate is not satisfied by a read-only check.

fault location.explanation: 写后缺少受认可的验证命令。
非取消错误统一映射为 StopError。

Root cause: 已确认：写入后 final-readiness 要求 ledger 中出现受认可的 verification 命令；普通读取不必然算 verification。该门槛失败产生 runErr，ACP 将所有非取消 runErr 映射为 StopError，即使文件写入已成功。ABB 的协议校验随后拒绝该 stopReason。不能仅凭 step failed 判 hit，必须排除 provider 401 等真实失败并检查 readiness 原因。维护者确认 PR #8916 修复并随 1.25.3 发布；本次未运行新 ABB 实验。 核对版 pinned_contains_fix 按本文件 commit_version 理解为 false（该测试提交仍含缺陷）；原始 case 的 true 不应解释为历史测试提交已修复。 归档最终 GT 记录：10 of 10 valid independent ABB executions (fresh Suite and container each)，模型 zhipu/glm-5.3-flash；这是归档结果，本次未重跑。原始归档中的早期失败或未到达记录不纳入上述有效复现统计；本精简目录不收录探索批次。
